Daniel Island Sunday Ride

Charleston, SC · Daniel Island

No-dropBeginner friendly

Daniel Island Sunday Ride is a road group ride in Charleston, SC. It meets every Sunday, 10:00 am (2:00 pm in winter), starting at Guggenheim Park. Expect about 12 / 18 / 30 miles, 14–16 mph.

About the Daniel Island Sunday Ride group ride

No-drop Sunday ride with three distance options so you can bail early. Fourteen to sixteen miles an hour. Moves to 2 pm in the winter months.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
